capabilities.direct_trigger: Run an end-to-end non-trivial repository workflow.
capabilities.negative_trigger: A single bounded specialist outcome can be invoked directly.
capabilities.owner: authority, requirement-understanding class and continuation, continuity mode, evidence-driven capability activation, root implementation integration, business continuity, knowledge disposition, and final claim state

capabilities.direct_trigger: Establish repository roots, instructions, current behavior, affected paths, controls, or a missing knowledge owner before the next decision.
capabilities.negative_trigger: The request is self-contained and has no repository dependency.
primary_outputs: canonical owner and reader path when topology is unclear
capabilities.owner: roots, instructions, path-specific artifact facts, current behavior, repository controls, bounded specialist discovery, neutral capability outcomes, and context gaps
stops: repository fact cannot be resolved safely

capabilities.direct_trigger: Audit, bootstrap, or repair repository knowledge, including missing entry points, chat-only handoff, ambiguous owners, duplicate or stale truth, and unresolved durable strategy.
capabilities.negative_trigger: An ordinary task only updates one already-owned nearby document, or the request is release execution.
primary_outputs: canonical owner, reader path, freshness signal, and minimum continuity record
capabilities.owner: repository shape, documentation inventory, knowledge placement, progressive disclosure, human-and-agent readability, bootstrap disposition, and deterministic knowledge drift
consumes: knowledge owner and workspace authority decisions
stops: clear existing owner makes additional topology unnecessary

capabilities.direct_trigger: Create, change, explain, diff, promote, retire, waive, or audit profile assets.
capabilities.negative_trigger: Ordinary task only consumes an existing effective snapshot.
capabilities.owner: profile lifecycle, resolution, authority-safe quality-policy coverage, conflict explanation, and concise instruction projection

capabilities.direct_trigger: Resolve material product semantics, scope, compatibility, permission, lifecycle, recovery, or approval before technical design.
capabilities.negative_trigger: Clear bounded work has no material alternative or contract change.
primary_outputs: representative examples, counterexamples, states, and recovery semantics
canonical requirement owner and technical-design handoff
capabilities.owner: understanding-depth classification, user-owned semantics, Default-mode confirmation boundary, acceptance, scope, compatibility intent, and durable design decisions
consumes: product and UX intent when applicable
stops: design premise contradicted by current facts

capabilities.direct_trigger: Establish product intent, real user journeys, information architecture, states, recovery, accessibility, or rendered design truth.
primary_outputs: implementation-ready state, recovery, and accessibility handoff
capabilities.owner: product and UX intent, protected interface behavior, and UX Ready

capabilities.direct_trigger: Reproduce and diagnose a bug, failure, flake, crash, hang, anomaly, or other causal uncertainty.
capabilities.negative_trigger: The task has no incorrect behavior or causal uncertainty.
primary_outputs: earliest bad state and code, command, harness, environment, or platform classification
capabilities.owner: reproduction, competing hypotheses, earliest root cause, invariant, and regression oracle proposal
stops: repeated hypotheses fail without new evidence
observation boundary prevents discriminating the remaining hypotheses

capabilities.direct_trigger: Make a material boundary, ownership, state, lifecycle, concurrency, compatibility, FFI, recovery, or performance choice.
capabilities.negative_trigger: Existing sound architecture resolves the bounded implementation without a material choice.
primary_outputs: smallest credible option, alternatives, falsification evidence, and revisit trigger
capabilities.owner: types, boundaries, ownership, state, concurrency, lifecycle, compatibility mechanics, and performance architecture

capabilities.direct_trigger: Fill a demonstrated capability gap by adding or materially expanding a dependency, tool, plugin, service, generator, or runtime.
capabilities.negative_trigger: Routine use of an existing approved capability without a graph, supply-chain, service, or runtime decision.
primary_outputs: existing-capability check, primary-source and supply-chain evidence, migration and exit path
capabilities.owner: candidate comparison, named approval, graph, supply chain, migration, rollback, and removal

capabilities.direct_trigger: Create a missing project-native test system or change/diagnose discovery, selection, harness wiring, oracle sensitivity, fixture isolation, runner interpretation, or false-green behavior.
capabilities.negative_trigger: Ordinary feature tests whose discovery, harness, fixtures, runner, and oracle sensitivity are already trustworthy.
primary_outputs: harness validity evidence and verification handoff
capabilities.owner: test-system construction and integrity: discovery, selection, harness wiring, fixture isolation, runner interpretation, oracle sensitivity, negative controls, flake discrimination, and cleanup; it cannot declare product correctness
consumes: suspect test result or harness change
stops: product semantics mistaken for harness semantics

capabilities.direct_trigger: Derive and execute risk-based black-box and white-box evidence for a repository claim.
capabilities.negative_trigger: No product or repository claim requires verification.
capabilities.owner: separate black-box and white-box derivation, risk-based oracles, test validity, native checks, environments, resources, evidence, and evidence status
consumes: current change or frozen read-only target

capabilities.direct_trigger: Independently review frozen source or a frozen intent and change.
capabilities.negative_trigger: No frozen source/change scope or applicable governed risk requires independent review.
capabilities.owner: blue and red review, finding verification, classification, severity, and repair disposition
stops: review target is not stable enough to assess

capabilities.direct_trigger: Handle a task that may expose secrets, personal data, production/customer information, internal documents, or sensitive external actions.
capabilities.negative_trigger: The task is clearly public-only and has no sensitive source, connector, tool output, or external disclosure action.
capabilities.owner: surface-aware data classification, least-data handling, reference/local-compute/redaction choices, and disclosure limits

capabilities.direct_trigger: Assess explicit acceptance, commit, PR, release, migration execution, deployment, rollback, or external-delivery eligibility.
capabilities.negative_trigger: The task has no explicit delivery intent or delivery action to assess.
capabilities.owner: exact readiness level, functional Git units, changed-file accounting, UX and test evidence, runtime feedback, residual gates, rollback, and action-specific authority
stops: required failed flaky blocked or not-run cell

capabilities.direct_trigger: Explicitly maintain the Dev Flow suite itself.
capabilities.negative_trigger: Any ordinary product or repository task.
capabilities.owner: Skills, schemas, resolver, routing, hooks, migrations, governance, and evaluation policy
